verdict.rationale: Shopify's UCP flow documents the full checkout-session-to-order pipeline: create_checkout with negotiated payment_handlers, complete_checkout gated on 'Payment credential has been collected' and 'ready_for_complete' status, then order tracking via webhooks/get_order. However, complete_checkout requiring Token-tier trust with checkout-completion permission is described as an advanced/less common path, while the default documented flow is 'Build carts, convert them to checkouts, and hand off to the merchant for payment' via continue_url rather than a fully agent-driven delegated payment credential — escalation to buyer-completed checkout is treated as the common case, not the exception. missing for 10: hands-on/independent confirmation of a real delegated-payment-credential purchase completing end-to-end without buyer handoff, concrete detail on how payment credentials are delegated/tokenized (beyond payment_handlers naming e.g. Google Pay), and evidence this 'trusted agent' full-autonomy path is broadly available rather than a gated/waitlisted capability.
